role: exploratory: how much hand-off variety a small encoder needs before it generalises to an unseen convention
claim: Trained on one wrapper convention, the Banking77 encoder follows that convention's cue (the last line, or the words 'Current message:') and fails on others. This run trains the same recipe on 1, 2, 4 and 8 conventions and tests on four conventions that no model sees, with the target last, first and in the middle. Written before any of these models was scored.
base_recipe: program2.json encoder recipe, log loss, 512-token cap, GPU, float32 weights with a bfloat16 forward

training_inputs.wrapped: a convention drawn uniformly from the first k training conventions; 1 to 8 earlier messages, uniform; target first or last with equal probability
training_inputs.never_in_training: the target in the middle; the four held-out conventions; small talk; typed summaries

conventions.fields: target: the line that carries the current message. header: a line placed before a block of earlier messages, or null. earlier: the line for one earlier message.

test.items: the 500 context-pilot Banking77 test items with the pilot's eight distractors per item
test.conditions: clean; each held-out convention with the target last, first and in the middle (after four of the eight earlier messages); the first training convention in the same three positions; the pilot's small-talk and typed-summary conditions
test.temperature: one scalar per model, fit on the 400 clean Program 1 dev items
test.headline: mean accuracy over the twelve held-out-convention conditions, per level, with the range over seeds; also split by target position

not_saved: model weights; only scores and summaries are kept
